stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Ronald Crouch tops the card with 38 pts, double chance locked away and the recliner warming up.

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: No Blanks, No Blemishes
stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 8 - not a blemish yet

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 112 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 1 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Marylyn Groves travelled from Geraldton GC for this one, so the least we can do is buy a round.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 3 marker sitting 6th

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 17 & 18 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 14-18

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 19, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 14-18 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 7, wipe on hole 8 - the course corrects

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 3 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 3 threes and 3 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 15 on the front, 8 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: The Scoreless Wander
stories.detail: 6 wipes from the card - cutting carbs, apparently

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 6, 1-pointer on hole 7

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Led most of the day, run down to 3rd at the death
